---
name: Module proposal
about: Propose a new module or provider
labels: enhancement
---

**Module ID and layer** (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3):
e.g. `P7 Yocto Recipe Provider` — Layer 1

**Problem it solves** — which administrator workflow does this improve?

**Rules implemented** (R1–R8, see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §1):
e.g. R1 Upstream First, R3 CVE policy

**Data sources** — which upstream sources will it read? How are they
verified (R5) and cached (R2)?

**Tests** — how will the module's outputs be validated? Evidence chains
required for analysis modules (R3/R8).
